trello.name: Renew and deploy SSL and internal CA certificates with auto-renewal
trello.desc: Owner: Ben. Deadline: August 22nd (buffer before September 1st expiry). Renew the wildcard SSL cert for api.ourapp.com and deploy to the load balancers. In the same change window, rotate the internal CA cert that signs the service mesh (expires two weeks after the public one). Set up cert-manager for both certs so they auto-renew going forward. Acceptance criteria: both certs renewed, deployed, and managed by cert-manager for auto-renewal by August 22nd.

trello.name: Implement PDF export feature for reports
trello.desc: Owner: Aisha. Deadline: end of month. Deliverable includes two halves: backend renders the report to PDF using headless Chrome, and frontend adds the export button plus a progress state for large reports. Aisha will complete both halves herself. As part of finishing the feature, record a short demo GIF for the marketing changelog. Acceptance criteria: PDF export button functional in frontend with progress state, backend PDF rendering via headless Chrome working, and demo GIF recorded for marketing.

trello.name: Restore and maintain staging environment parity with production
trello.desc: Owner: Ben. Run the three pending migrations on staging today to catch up with production. Additionally, write a nightly job that diffs the staging schema against production and posts to the infra channel if they diverge. Acceptance criteria: staging is no longer behind production on migrations, and nightly diff job is deployed and posting alerts to infra channel on divergence.
